_README: Wiki-sourced corrections to a gear-planner affix NAME (#227). Global, not per-item: every occurrence of source_name becomes canonical_name. Applied by src/name_corrections.py BEFORE variant expansion and BEFORE rankable_affixes(), so one corrected affix block flows into verify/coverage, the picker vocabulary, the solver, browse, and the exports from one place. gear-planner remains the sole authority for WHICH affixes an item has; the wiki is the authority for what the enchantment is CALLED. Pair every entry with an affix_aliases.json entry mapping source_name -> canonical_name, so a player typing the gear-planner name still resolves.
_guards: The build FAILS when source_name is no longer present upstream (the rename has become a silent no-op) or when canonical_name is ALREADY a native gear-planner name (renaming onto it would merge two affixes upstream keeps distinct). A correction file that cannot go stale unnoticed is the only kind worth having.
_precedent: Movement Speed, Physical Sheltering, and Armor-Piercing are all native pipeline-minted names with the spoken variant (Striding, PRR, Fortification Bypass) aliased on top. An alias alone cannot do this job: the picker canonicalizes typed input, but the solver matches item affixes by name, so a canonical name no item carries scores zero.

corrections.evidence: The Enhancements list on Item:Legendary_Icewalkers renders 'Enhanced Ki'; the Enhanced Ki page describes it as increasing the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack. gear-planner stores the same enchantment as bare 'Ki' with a magnitude and no type.
corrections.reason: Reported by a player who could not find 'enhanced ki' in the priority picker. The stored name is a shortening, not a different enchantment: 19 worn variants across 5 slots carry values 1-5, matching the wiki's per-item values.
corrections.note: This affix is untyped upstream, so it is ALSO gated by data/seed/compendium/untyped_rankable.json. Renaming it does not by itself make it rankable.
corrections.channel: all channels. Inert until the 2026-08-18 refresh, which re-encoded the type field: `Ki` went from untyped (invisible to iter_affixes, #229's mask) to 20 gate-visible records typed `Untyped`, arming this entry.

all channels. Was augment-pool-only pre-refresh (two Solar Gem of Enduring stones); the 2026-08-18 refresh moved upstream to `False Life (%)` wholesale — 34 items / 2 crafting / 4 sets — while `Legendary Conditioning` left raw entirely, which is what arms this entry.
corrections.evidence: #376 — one mechanic stored under two names, so the two sat in separate buckets and SUMMED. ddowiki Conditioning: "This enchantment gives a +X% Legendary bonus to Maximum Hit points". Our only two False Life (%) carriers are the Solar Gem of Enduring pair, listed on Lunar_and_Solar_Gems as "Enduring - Legendary Bonus to Maximum Hit Points". Same mechanic, same bonus type, so they must share a bucket and take the highest: Baphomet's Reign 15% + Solar Gem 10% reported 25% where the game gives 15%. Flat False Life is a DIFFERENT enchantment (no percentage variant; Vitality/Profane/Insight/Enhancement/Quality across 510 items) and is untouched. No item carries both names.

corrections.channel: items, crafting and sets — renamed at each catalog's single load point (KTD2), so every derived pool inherits it
corrections.evidence: docs/wiki-evidence/spellpower-universal.md quotes ddowiki Spell_power / Equipment_bonus rendering the enchantment name ("+2 [[Combustion]] Scepter"). Measured against upstream master 2026-08-18: the refreshed snapshot carries the generic spelling and zero occurrences of ours; no item carries both, so this is one mechanic under two spellings and not a merge of two (the same-item co-occurrence rule).
corrections.reason: #374 — upstream generalized its affix vocabulary and now emits this name where its previous snapshot (and ours) emits the in-game enchantment name. KTD1 keeps our canon: the DDO wiki is this repo's source of truth and uses the enchantment names, so the app and the item tooltip say the same words. The paired affix_aliases.json entry keeps upstream's spelling resolving in the picker, so tooltip fidelity and search vocabulary are served separately.

corrections.channel: sets (one occurrence today); becomes the whole family's channel once U4's refresh consolidates upstream's spellings
corrections.evidence: docs/wiki-evidence/helpless-damage.md (#305): the ddowiki Helpless hub page lists every gear source of the ONE percent-extra-damage-vs-helpless mechanic in a single table, and the canonical spelling is the one carried natively by the Solar Gem of Cruelty affixes. Upstream consolidates the eleven spellings onto this one variant in the refreshed snapshot, which takes our canonical to zero occurrences in raw.
corrections.reason: #374 — the same canon-defence shape as the ten spell-power/lore flips, but a family consolidation rather than a vocabulary generalization. The #305 local_affix_synonyms folds stay: they cover the set-tier free-text channels this rename does not reach, and check_local_synonym_staleness is what makes their retirement visible.

corrections.evidence: https://ddowiki.com/page/Unconscious section 'Extending unconsciousness range' lists all sources together as enhancement bonuses to one range: 'Holding On: +40 enhancement bonus', 'Undying: enhancement bonus scaling with level', 'Undying Sapphire: +65 / +225 enhancement bonus', 'Weighty Asset: +100 enhancement bonus'. `Incapacitation range` (which the Undying enchantment links) REDIRECTS to that same page, so the two spellings are one mechanic. Harvested 2026-08-30.
corrections.note: #632 — merged INTO the existing `Undying` rather than renaming all three to the mechanic's own name. `Undying` is the name players actually rank and the dominant population (14 records); moving it would change a stat name in saved builds to fix 3 records. The engraved name survives as `via`, so the card still reads 'Weighty Asset'.

corrections.evidence: https://ddowiki.com/page/Cursed states the whole family in one list: 'Equipping a cursed item bestows a -1 penalty to one of your ability scores: Curse of Clumsiness: Passive: -1 Penalty to Dexterity. Curse of Dullness: Passive: -1 Penalty to Intelligence. Curse of Foolishness: Passive: -1 Penalty to Wisdom. Curse of Frailty: Passive: -1 Penalty to Constitution. Curse of Repulsiveness: Passive: -1 Penalty to Charisma. Curse of Weakness: Passive: -1 Penalty to Strength.' Named carriers use the same definition: Item:Ring of Baphomet renders 'Curse of Foolishness' and 'Curse of Repulsiveness' whose tooltips link that same Cursed page. Harvested 2026-08-30.
corrections.note: #615 — `Curse of Clumsiness` is not a stat, it is a -1 Penalty to Dexterity. Merged so it lands in the Dexterity total the player actually ranks; the engraved curse name rides on `via`, so the card still names the curse.

_pending: #374/U2 — an entry may carry pending_upstream + pending_reason when it is declared one unit AHEAD of the refreshed gear-planner snapshot that arms it. Pending entries are exempt from assert_all_reached (they reach nothing by construction) and excluded from the KTD3 declared-live set. The exemption is self-retiring: assert_canon_defense fails the build the moment the raw data arms an entry whose marker is still set.
_canon_defense: #374/KTD3 — canon_defense marks an entry that defends one of OUR enchantment names against an upstream vocabulary flip. src/name_corrections.assert_canon_defense compares the live (non-pending) canon_defense set against vocabulary.armed_canon_variants(), derived from the raw snapshot by the direct Rule A predicate, and fails in EITHER direction. Never hand-list the armed set: a hand-list is right once and rots at the next refresh, silently.
